guard_streams.write_limit: A data-download landing page identifies dataset families and documentation; exact current parcel promotion requires the relevant file, schema, version and row-level join to be validated.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Connected Nations 2025 data-download page on 19 November 2025.
The page states that the downloads underpin the Connected Nations 2025 report.
The downloads are intended to support year-on-year comparisons of UK communications infrastructure.
The page lists a fixed-broadband-coverage dataset.
It lists full-fibre take-up data for local and unitary authorities.
An accompanying about-the-data resource is listed for fixed-broadband coverage and full-fibre take-up.
The page lists a fixed-broadband-performance dataset.
An accompanying data-description resource is listed for fixed-broadband performance.
The page lists a mobile-coverage dataset.
The page provides a Connected Nations data-team contact route for questions and feedback.

guard_streams.source: UK home broadband performance, measurement period March 2022
guard_streams.write_limit: Panel-based router measurements and provider-supplied performance data are historical research samples; they are not measurements for the selected parcel and cannot establish current coverage.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the March 2022 home-broadband-performance report on 21 October 2022.
The page was last updated on 17 March 2023.
The report notes that 87 percent of UK households took a home fixed-broadband service.
The research was designed to understand how residential fixed-broadband services were performing.
One source dataset came from a SamKnows volunteer panel using hardware monitoring units connected to routers.
A second source dataset was supplied to Ofcom by broadband providers.
The research measures performance delivered to the consumer's router rather than every end-user device.
Ofcom published a technical report for the March 2022 measurement period.
Chart data was published alongside the report.
Panellist data was also made available for the measurement period.
